title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery files for review and approval from the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Trigen-Boston Energy Corporation.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chariman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, and Judith F. Judson. (DTE05-GC-8)
